paragraphs.text: The changing of a single moment in Tarkir's past altered its future, rewriting its history.
Ugin's magic reaches beyond the dragons. The clans have adapted it for war.
"There are many different paths. The Great Teacher reveals them all."
Weakness exists within all who are not dragons.
"Your enemies may be cowardly, my lord, but one should never call them gutless."
To the Sultai, Ugin's power was just one more resource to be exploited.
"The ainok are wild dogs, not fit to join us around the fire." —Surrak, the Hunt Caller
Anger can empower those who embrace it.
Only those who have proved themselves worthy are granted a dragon's scale.
A howl on the wind hides many dangers.
"Their origins are shrouded in mystery. I believe they are the protectors of the lost secrets of our world." —Jilaya, Temur whisperer
While trapping the Eldrazi on Zendikar, Ugin learned little from Sorin, but he gleaned the rudiments of lithomancy from Nahiri.
Supplicants offer flesh and silver, flowers and blood. The altar takes what it will, eyes gleaming with unspoken promises.
The bigger the hand, the higher the price.
If you fear the dragon's fire, you are unworthy to wield it.
